'''''Jedi — The Dark Side'' 2''' is the second of five issues in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries. Set in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], the series will follow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]] as they [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|attempt]] to prevent [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]] from erupting on Xanatos's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Telos IV]]. It was released on [[June 22]], [[2011]].

==Publisher's summary==
''Dispatched to the planet Telos IV, Qui-Gon, his Padawan Xanatos, and the lovely Jedi Master Tahl must uncover the secrets behind a recent political assassination and prevent an outbreak of civil war. For the headstrong Xanatos, this return to the world of his birth has dredged up hidden resentments, while Master Tahl has herself become a target for assassination!''

''Intrigue, action, danger, and the dark side are imminent!''

''Years before the events in Star Wars: Episode I, before Obi-Wan Kenobi was his Padawan, and before he met Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn had his first encounters with the dark side….''

==Plot summary==
{{Plot|comic}}

==Continuity==
In the story, a road called [[Chodo Habat Parkway]] was mentioned as existing on the planet of Telos IV. [[Chodo Habat]] was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] from ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' who led the [[Telosian Restoration Project]], healing the world's surface following the [[Bombing of Telos IV]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
